raw.query: WITH m AS (SELECT model, resolution, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT origin) AS origins, MIN(origin) AS first_origin, MAX(origin) AS last_origin, SUM(ABS(y_true)) AS denominator, SUM(ABS(point-y_true)) AS abs_error FROM provenance.v_forecast_thesis_corpus WHERE model IN ('holt_winters','naive') AND mode='uni' AND variate='images' AND h=1 AND origin>=8076 AND resolution IN ('15s','1min') GROUP BY model, resolution) SELECT model, resolution, n, origins, first_origin, last_origin, ROUND(denominator::numeric,3) AS denominator, ROUND(abs_error::numeric,3) AS abs_error, ROUND((abs_error/NULLIF(denominator,0))::numeric,6) AS wape FROM m ORDER BY resolution, model
raw.observed: 15s: Holt-Winters WAPE=0.991748 vs naive=0.763780; 1min: Holt-Winters WAPE=0.594638 vs naive=0.618000; denominator=977602 at 15s and 432707 at 1min
raw.evidence: Holt-Winters is worse at 15s but better than naive at 1min, so the every-column claim is contradicted.
